message.tm_wagon.wrong_slot: Wrong mounting position or wheel size. Small wheels go at the front, large wheels at the rear.
message.tm_wagon.occupied: This slot is occupied. Remove its part first.
message.tm_wagon.body_required: Place a cargo compartment on the assembly frame first.
message.tm_wagon.frame_required: Install this on an assembly frame or at a cargo compartment mounting point.
message.tm_wagon.out_of_bounds: Outside the build area or a required chunk is not loaded.
message.tm_wagon.blocked: Clear the entire area occupied by this part.
message.tm_wagon.entity_blocked: Move entities out of the installation area.
message.tm_wagon.controller_unloaded: The assembly frame chunk must be loaded before dismantling.
tooltip.tm_wagon.cargo_body: Use on the frame top to place a cargo compartment, footboard and both steps. 10 cargo slots.
tooltip.tm_wagon.single_horse_shafts: Mount: 2 blocks forward, 1 block up from the frame, centered.
tooltip.tm_wagon.double_horse_shafts: Mount: 2 blocks forward, 1 block up from the frame, centered.
tooltip.tm_wagon.single_seat: Mount: 2 blocks forward, 2 blocks up from the frame, centered.
tooltip.tm_wagon.double_seat: Mount: 2 blocks forward, 2 blocks up from the frame, centered.
tooltip.tm_wagon.small_wheel: Front axle: 1 forward, 1 left or right, at frame level.
tooltip.tm_wagon.large_wheel: Rear axle: 1 back (2 for an extended compartment), 1 left or right, at frame level.
message.tm_wagon.frame_extend_first: Fully extend the lift before installing any components.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_assembly_frame: Right-click an empty lift to fold/unfold; assemble complete parts or restore a wagon above a folded lift.
message.tm_wagon.incomplete_assembly: Incomplete assembly: cargo body, seat, shafts, two small front wheels and two large rear wheels are required.
message.tm_wagon.assembly_busy: Assembly or restoration is in progress. Wait for the lift to finish.
message.tm_wagon.spawn_failed: Could not spawn the wagon. All components were preserved.
message.tm_wagon.wagon_missing: The wagon left the lift area or is not loaded.
message.tm_wagon.restore_failed: Could not restore wagon blocks: %s The lift will fold back down.
message.tm_wagon.seat_occupied: This seat is occupied. Click the other seat.
message.tm_wagon.lead_horse_required: Bring an adult horse or donkey on your lead to this hitch.
message.tm_wagon.hitch_blocked: Clear the horse position and provide nearby ground.
message.tm_wagon.cargo_unsupported: This block cannot be loaded as cargo (multi-block structures are unsupported)
message.tm_wagon.cargo_filtered: This block is not permitted by the cargo filter
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_straw_mat: Place across three empty cargo slots toward the front. Sleep without setting a respawn point; sneak-use to remove.
message.tm_wagon.mat_space: Not enough space: three consecutive empty cargo slots toward the front are required.
message.tm_wagon.mat_dimension: You cannot sleep on a straw mat in this dimension.
message.tm_wagon.mat_unstable: Stop and steady the wagon before sleeping.
message.tm_wagon.mat_unavailable: You cannot use the straw mat to sleep right now.
message.tm_wagon.cargo_blocked: This cargo position is obstructed by a block or entity
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_stool: Place only in wagon cargo slots; right-click to sit, sneak-right-click to remove
tooltip.tm_wagon.long_cargo_body: Use on the frame top to place a compartment extended by one rear row. 12 cargo slots.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_cargo_cover: Use a block-form cargo wall to install. Use the fabric to roll back one row; sneak-use to spread it. Sneak-use a block-form cargo wall to remove.
message.tm_wagon.cover_block_only: Cargo covers can only be installed or removed on a block-form wagon.
message.tm_wagon.cover_installed: This compartment already has a cargo cover.
message.tm_wagon.cover_side: Use a cargo wall to install or remove the cover, or use the fabric or roll to adjust it.
message.tm_wagon.cover_blocked: An entity or block obstructs the new fabric. The cover cannot change.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_canopy: Install on a block-form cargo wall; sneak-use the wall to remove. Use either curtain to toggle it. Mutually exclusive with the cargo cover.
message.tm_wagon.roof_conflict: A canopy and cargo cover cannot be installed together.
message.tm_wagon.canopy_block_only: Canopies can only be installed or removed on a block-form wagon.
message.tm_wagon.canopy_side: Use a cargo wall to install or remove the canopy, or use either curtain to open or close it.
message.tm_wagon.canopy_blocked: An entity or block obstructs the canopy or curtain. It cannot change.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_cabinet: Install on the lower seat side in block form. Sneak-use to remove and spill contents in either form. Use either drawer end to open. Single seat: 27 slots; double seat: 54 slots.
message.tm_wagon.cabinet_block_only: Install the cabinet while the wagon is in block form.
message.tm_wagon.cabinet_side: Use the side below the driver seat or either drawer end.
